_comment: EDIT YOUR REAL PRICES HERE. The website estimator and JARVIS (chat) both read this file. Ranges are [low, high].

surcharges._comment: Only added when the item is seen in a photo or mentioned. TDS landfill (Oct 2026): mattress/box spring/sofa/recliner $25 each, Freon removal $50, tires $8-80 off rim. Our prices = gate fee + handling.

dump_fee._comment: MINIMUM dump fee per load size (floor), TDS Creedmoor confirmed by phone Nov 2026: $12/cu yd uncompacted, $66 min incl. first 5.5 yd, + WWM 14.5% + RCR 3.6% + environmental $16 small / $30 large load. Full 15 yd ≈ $243.

dump_rates._comment: TDS Creedmoor (confirmed by phone Nov 2026): uncompacted $12/cu yd, $66 minimum incl. 5.5 yd, + fees (~18%) + environmental $16/$30. Clean brush $10/yd ($20 min). Clean concrete/rock/dirt: no charge. Mixed concrete $60/ton (2-ton min). Unsecured load $35 — always tarp.

mileage._comment: Distance from Austin base. First free_miles are free, then per_mile. city_miles is used when the exact distance is unknown.

_price_point_comment: One single price: 0 = lowest of each range, 1 = highest, 0.5 = middle. Rounded up to the next $5.
_single_note: Single item all-in ≈ $129–149 (truck $39 + labor ~$38 + disposal $30 + fuel $25). Competitive with national chains (~$125 avg sofa).
_load_prices_note: All-in website prices (labor + truck + TDS + fuel): 1/4 ≈ $275, 1/2 ≈ $425, 3/4 ≈ $550, full ≈ $695. Real cost ≈ $227 / $290 / $375 / $492 → ~25% margin. Austin market: half $200–400, full avg ~$675.
